def reducedResidues (delta : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range delta).filter (fun b ↦ b.Coprime delta)

theorem card_reducedResidues (delta : ℕ) :
    (reducedResidues delta).card = delta.totient := by
  simp only [reducedResidues, Nat.totient_eq_card_coprime, Nat.coprime_comm]

def coprimeMass {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → R) (q : ℕ) : R :=
  ∑ n ∈ N, if n.Coprime q then beta n else 0

def residueMass {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → R) (q delta b : ℕ) : R :=
  ∑ n ∈ N, if n.Coprime q ∧ Nat.ModEq delta n b then beta n else 0

def covariance (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → ℂ) (q r : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ b ∈ reducedResidues (q.gcd r),
    (residueMass N beta q (q.gcd r) b - coprimeMass N beta q / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℂ)) *
      star (residueMass N beta r (q.gcd r) b -
        coprimeMass N beta r / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℂ))

theorem covariance_identity (N : Finset ℕ) (beta : ℕ → ℂ) {q r : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    compatibleMass N beta q r -
      coprimeMass N beta q * star (coprimeMass N beta r) / ((q.gcd r).totient : ℂ) =
        covariance N beta q r := by

theorem actual_rawZero_eq_compatibleMass (d : MediumAtom) :
    d.transposedAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart =
      ((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∑ a ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, ∑ b ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
          d.complexFactorGamma a * star (d.complexFactorGamma b) *
            compatibleMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha
              (complexFactorModulus a) (complexFactorModulus b) /
                ((complexFactorModulus a).lcm (complexFactorModulus b) : ℂ) := by

theorem actual_rawZero_sub_primitive_eq_covariance
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    d.transposedAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart - primitiveZeroMain d =
      ((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
          d.groupedFactorGamma q * star (d.groupedFactorGamma r) *
            covariance d.alphaCarrier d.alpha q r / (q.lcm r : ℂ) := by

theorem MediumAtom.gamma1L2_primitive_eq
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ p ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2 := by

theorem MediumAtom.signedError_norm_sq_le_sharedFirstFactorMomentDispersion
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    ‖d.signedError‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (4 * d.V * d.Q1 * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1)) *
        ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
          ((d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionW
              d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight -
            2 * (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionV
              d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight +
            (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionU
              d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight) := by

lemma charParseval_units {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (T : ZMod q → ℂ) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖∑ x : ZMod q, star (χ x) * T x‖ ^ 2) =
      (q.totient : ℝ) * ∑ x : ZMod q, (if IsUnit x then ‖T x‖ ^ 2 else 0) := by
  have hC : (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (‖∑ x : ZMod q, star (χ x) * T x‖ ^ 2 : ℂ)) =

theorem weighted_primitive_bombieri_davenport_explicit (b : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℤ)
    (N Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
        ∑ χ : PrimitiveCharacter q,
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N),
            b n * χ.1 (n : ZMod q)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((N : ℝ) +
        (2 * (Nat.ceil (Real.log ((Q : ℝ) ^ 2) / Real.log 2) : ℝ) + 12) *
          (Q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (M + 1) (M + N), ‖b n‖ ^ 2 := by

prime_diagonal_dictionary.scope: Illustrative prime p>=2, fixed tails v1=v2=1, gamma tails supported at1, h1=h2=1. This is not an allowed restriction of the general actual target. p in actual primitiveFirstFactorCarrier is merely coprime |a| and can be composite.
prime_diagonal_dictionary.centered_class_error: E_p(b)=sum_{n in original alphaCarrier,n==b(mod p)}alpha(n) - sum_{n in alphaCarrier,(n,p)=1}alpha(n)/phi(p), for reduced b. Exact primitive center is retained.
prime_diagonal_dictionary.variance: covariance(alpha,p,p)=sum_{b reduced modp}|E_p(b)|^2 = (1/phi(p))*sum_{chi modp,chi!=1}|S(chi)|^2. Principal-subtracted Parseval follows finite all-character unit Parseval; for prime p the nonprincipal characters are primitive. That specialization/dictionary is hand-checked, not an existing newly proved Lean endpoint.
prime_diagonal_dictionary.actual_zero_contribution: Z=V*localCutoffMass*sum_{p~Q} [1/(p*phi(p))]*sum_{chi!=1}|S(chi)|^2. Here1/p is the actual lcm(p,p)^(-1), independent of the1/phi(p) from Parseval.
prime_diagonal_dictionary.relative_to_LS_weight: (V*localCutoffMass/(p*phi(p)))/(p/phi(p)) = V*localCutoffMass/p^2. Thus p>=Q gives |Z| <= V*|localCutoffMass|/Q^2 * [N+(2ceil(log(Qmax^2)/log2)+12)Qmax^2] * alphaL2, using actual integer support length N and cutoff Qmax. N is at most the chosen upper-endpoint interval length, typically about2U; Qmax about2Q.
prime_diagonal_dictionary.contrast_of_objects: The AP variance sum without its lcm factor instead has coefficient1/p relative to primitive LS, hence (U/Q+Q)*alphaL2 up to endpoint constants/logs. Multiplying this whole upper bound by a coarse uniformV without preserving1/p would lose the second inversep.
prime_diagonal_dictionary.outer_normalized_scale: With the existing outside factor of order VQ, alphaL2 of order U times its fixed divisor-moment logarithm, and X=UV, the squared-budget scale from this prime diagonal lane is X^2*(1/Q+Q/U) up to localCutoffMass, fixed logs and dyadic constants. No arbitrary-real-A log payment is asserted.

general_shared_tail_dictionary.variables: Physical moduli q=p*v1,r=p*v2, d=gcd(v1,v2)>0, Lres=lcm(v1,v2)>0; delta=gcd(q,r)=p*d and lcm(q,r)=p*Lres for arbitrary positive p,v1,v2. No p-coprime-tail assumption is needed for these integer identities.
general_shared_tail_dictionary.auxiliary_sieves: h1=v1/d and h2=v2/d. On reduced residue classes modulo p*d, original physical coprime masks reduce to these exact auxiliary sieves. They are independent of p for fixed tails.
general_shared_tail_dictionary.covariance_character_form: The two centered class masses have complex cross Parseval (1/phi(p*d))*sum_nonprincipal S_h1(chi)*conj(S_h2(chi)); Cauchy or the half-squares bound can majorize the cross product. Both original masks and center totals must remain exact.
general_shared_tail_dictionary.raw_weight: Actual zero covariance weight including local mass is V*localCutoffMass/(p*Lres*phi(p*d)). Relative to the character square weight (p*d)/phi(p*d), its scalar is V*localCutoffMass/(p^2*d*Lres). The second inverse p survives before any conductor regrouping.
general_shared_tail_dictionary.not_yet_a_supplier: For composite p*d, all nonprincipal characters are not all primitive. The established primitive LS cannot replace the entire all-character cross variance without proved conductor/auxiliary-mask/weight handling. The earlier explicit bad-support correction and any analytic-supply premises remain visible; none is declared paid here.
general_shared_tail_dictionary.aggregation_limit: This computation is per shared p and fixed physical tail pair, with the original gamma2/gamma3 labels and conjugations. It does not estimate their final sum, dyadic conductor windows, varying d, literal U/V residuals, full W frequencies, or moving-residue slow phase.

actionable_consequence: A future honest high-conductor ledger should start from the V/(p^2*d*Lres) coefficient rather than discard one inverse p. Existing no-matching-endpoint finding must not be strengthened into a nonpayment/impossibility claim based on the coarser normalization.
